entities.summary: Tania Maria (b. 1948-05-09, São Luís) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in São Luís and Brazil. Known in the fields of brazil, composers & musicians, americas.
